versions.subject: feat: first batch update for regsvr32
feat: update more regsvr32
versions.detection:
selection:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\regsvr32.exe'
    Image|endswith:
        - '\calc.exe'
        - '\cscript.exe'
        - '\explorer.exe'
        - '\mshta.exe'
        - '\net.exe'
        - '\net1.exe'
        - '\nltest.exe'
        - '\notepad.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
        - '\pwsh.exe'
        - '\reg.exe'
        - '\schtasks.exe'
        - '\werfault.exe'
        - '\wscript.exe'
filter_main_werfault:
    Image|endswith: '\werfault.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: ' -u -p '
condition: selection
